title: 2020 AMC 12B Problem 19

solutions.text:
Label the vertices \(0,1,2,3\) cyclically. Each allowed transformation has the form \(j\mapsto \varepsilon j+\delta\pmod 4,\) where \(\varepsilon\in\{1,-1\}\) and \(\delta\in\{1,-1\}.\) These four choices give exactly the two quarter-turns and the two stated reflections.

Under composition, the parity of \(\delta\) changes at every move. Thus a composition of \(19\) allowed transformations again has odd \(\delta,\) and so is one of the four allowed transformations. Its inverse is also allowed. Consequently every sequence of the first \(19\) moves has exactly one choice for the final move, giving \(4^{19}=2^{38}\) successful sequences.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
